story.title: From Humble Beginnings to Medical Excellence
story.p1: Founded in 1988 by Dr. Eleanor Rigby with a small team of dedicated nurses, Everleaf Medical Center started with a simple mission: to provide accessible, high-quality healthcare to the local community.
story.p2: Today, we have grown into a 500-bed multi-specialty quaternary care hospital. Despite our expansion, our core philosophy remains unchanged—putting the patient first. We are driven by the belief that healthcare is not just about treating diseases, but about healing people.

preventive-cardiology.title: 5 Essential Tips for Preventive Heart Health
preventive-cardiology.excerpt: Heart disease remains the leading cause of death globally, yet up to 80% of cardiovascular diseases are preventable. Learn the five evidence-based strategies our cardiologists recommend.
preventive-cardiology.seoTitle: Preventive Cardiology: 5 Essential Tips for Heart Health
preventive-cardiology.seoDescription: Expert cardiologist advice on preventing heart disease through lifestyle changes, regular screenings, and proactive care.
preventive-cardiology.author: Dr. Mark Williams
preventive-cardiology.authorBio: Dr. Williams is a dedicated cardiologist focusing on preventive heart care and minimally invasive surgical procedures. He leads our comprehensive cardiovascular wellness program.

0.text: Heart disease remains the leading cause of death globally, yet up to 80% of cardiovascular diseases are preventable through lifestyle modifications and early intervention. At EverLeaf Medical Center, our cardiology department emphasizes proactive care to help you maintain a healthy heart for life.

1.text: "The best time to start caring for your heart was 20 years ago. The second best time is now," says Dr. Mark Williams, Chief of Cardiology. Here are five evidence-based strategies to protect your cardiovascular health.

3.text: Regular health screenings are the foundation of preventive cardiology. Understanding your key health metrics enables early detection and intervention.

diabetes-management.title: New Breakthrough in Diabetes Management Using AI Technology
diabetes-management.excerpt: EverLeaf's latest clinical trial shows AI-driven diabetes management can reduce A1C levels by 2.5% and increase time-in-range from 55% to 78%.
diabetes-management.author: Dr. Mark Williams
diabetes-management.authorBio: Dr. Williams is also a leading researcher in the field of endocrinology, exploring the intersections between heart health and metabolic disorders like diabetes.

immune-system.title: 5 Superfoods to Boost Your Immune System This Winter
immune-system.excerpt: As winter approaches, these five superfoods can give your immune system the vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants it needs to stay strong.
immune-system.author: Dr. Emily Rodriguez
immune-system.authorBio: Dr. Rodriguez treats hormonal disorders including diabetes, thyroid conditions, and metabolic syndrome. She is passionate about functional nutrition and its role in immune health.

pediatric-wing.title: EverLeaf Opens New Pediatric Wing in West Wing
pediatric-wing.excerpt: EverLeaf Medical Center's new Pediatric Wing features 50 private rooms, a dedicated pediatric emergency department, and specialized play therapy zones.
pediatric-wing.author: Dr. Emily Chen
pediatric-wing.authorBio: Dr. Chen is a passionate pediatrician known for her gentle approach and expertise in early childhood development. She oversaw the design and implementation of the new pediatric wing.

anxiety-in-teens.title: Recognizing the Early Signs of Anxiety in Teenagers
anxiety-in-teens.excerpt: Anxiety disorders are increasingly common among teenagers. Identifying the symptoms early can lead to better outcomes and prevent long-term struggles.
anxiety-in-teens.author: Dr. Rachel Green
anxiety-in-teens.authorBio: Dr. Green specializes in cognitive behavioral therapy and mental health support for chronic illness patients. She works closely with families to create supportive environments for teens facing anxiety and depression.

flu-season.title: Flu Season 2025: Why the Vaccine is More Important Than Ever
flu-season.excerpt: With pandemic-era precautions relaxed, viruses are circulating more freely. Here's why getting your flu shot this season is more critical than ever.
flu-season.author: Dr. Bereket Kinfe
flu-season.authorBio: Dr. Kinfe is an expert in diagnosing and treating complex infectious diseases. He leads EverLeaf's annual community vaccination program and advises on seasonal flu prevention strategies.

senior-mobility.title: Mobility in Seniors: The Link Between Walking and Cognitive Health
senior-mobility.excerpt: A new study found that seniors who maintained a brisk walking pace were 40% less likely to develop cognitive impairment. Here's what you can do.
senior-mobility.author: Dr. Sarah Johnson
senior-mobility.authorBio: Dr. Johnson specializes in complex neurological disorders with over 15 years of experience. Her research focuses on the connection between physical mobility and cognitive health in aging adults.

hero.description: Our Level I Trauma Center is staffed 24/7 by board-certified emergency physicians and specialized nurses, ready to handle any medical crisis with expertise, speed, and compassion.

intro.title: 24/7 Trauma & Critical Care
intro.description1: Everleaf's Emergency Department is a state-of-the-art facility designed to provide comprehensive emergency services to patients of all ages. From minor injuries to life-threatening conditions, our team is prepared for everything.
intro.description2: We utilize the latest in medical technology, including advanced imaging (CT, MRI) located directly within the ED for immediate diagnostics, ensuring that treatment decisions are made rapidly and accurately.

ambulance.description: Our fleet of advanced life support ambulances is strategically positioned to ensure the fastest response times in the region.

1.title: Triage Assessment

2.title: Diagnosis & Treatment
2.description: You will be seen by an emergency physician for examination, testing, and treatment. We aim to discharge or admit you as efficiently as possible.

0.title: Cardiac Care Team

microbiology.title: Microbiology

intro.title: Comprehensive Pharmaceutical Care

prescription.title: Prescription Management

consultation.title: Consultation Services
consultation.description: Speak directly with our clinical pharmacists in private consultation rooms. We provide detailed counseling on medication side effects, proper usage, and lifestyle adjustments for optimal results.

delivery.title: Medicine Delivery
delivery.description: Cannot make it to the pharmacy? We offer secure and prompt home delivery services for your prescriptions and medical supplies within the city limits, ensuring you never miss a dose.

otc.description: Browse our extensive selection of non-prescription medications, vitamins, supplements, and first-aid supplies. Our staff is always available to help you choose the right product.

seo.description: Comprehensive health screening packages for all ages. Detect health issues early with our executive checkups.

hero.title: Invest in Your Health with Comprehensive Checkups
hero.description: Early detection is key to a long, healthy life. Our personalized screening packages provide a complete picture of your health status in a comfortable environment.

importance.title: The Importance of Early Detection
importance.description: Many chronic diseases are silent in their early stages. Regular health screenings can detect problems before they start, giving you the best chance for effective treatment and a healthy future.

heart.title: Heart Health
heart.description: Identify risk factors like high blood pressure and cholesterol early to prevent heart disease and stroke.

diabetes.title: Diabetes Screening
diabetes.description: Early detection of pre-diabetes allows for lifestyle changes that can prevent or delay the onset of Type 2 diabetes.

cancer.title: Cancer Prevention
cancer.description: Screening tests can find some cancers early, when treatment is most likely to be successful.

packages.title: Comprehensive Screening Packages
packages.description: Choose the package that best fits your age, lifestyle, and health concerns.

basic.title: Basic Wellness
basic.description: Essential health monitoring for young adults.

wellness.title: Customized Wellness Plans
wellness.description: Your checkup results are just the beginning. Our medical team works with you to create a personalized roadmap to better health, focusing on nutrition, exercise, and lifestyle adjustments tailored to your unique biological profile.

nutrition.title: Personalized Nutrition
nutrition.description: Dietary recommendations based on your blood work.

activity.title: Activity Guidance
activity.description: Safe exercise routines for your fitness level.

cta.description: Take the first step towards a healthier future. Book your preventive checkup today with our simple online scheduling tool.

seo.title: Cardiology Department
seo.description: World-class heart care and cardiology services. Expert diagnosis and treatment for cardiovascular conditions.

hero.description: Our Cardiology Department provides comprehensive care for heart and vascular conditions. From advanced diagnostics to surgical treatments, we are committed to your heart health.

expertise.title: Services & Procedures
expertise.description: Our cardiology department offers a full spectrum of heart care services, from advanced non-invasive diagnostics to complex surgical interventions.

conditions.title: Conditions We Treat
conditions.description: We specialize in diagnosing and treating a wide range of cardiovascular conditions using the latest medical advancements.

0.title: Coronary Artery Disease
0.description: Treatment for narrowed or blocked blood vessels that can lead to heart attack.

1.title: Heart Failure
1.description: Comprehensive management plans for chronic heart failure conditions.

2.title: Arrhythmia
2.description: Expert care for irregular heartbeats, including atrial fibrillation.

3.title: Valvular Heart Disease
3.description: Repair and replacement therapies for damaged heart valves.

cta.description: Don't wait for symptoms to worsen. Our expert cardiologists are here to provide the personalized care you deserve. Schedule your consultation now.

seo.title: Dental Clinic
seo.description: Comprehensive dental and oral healthcare. From routine cleanings to complex oral surgeries and orthodontics.

hero.description: Our specialized dental clinic combines advanced technology with compassionate care to ensure your smile is healthy and beautiful. From routine check-ups to complex oral surgeries.

conditions.title: Conditions We Treat
conditions.description: We provide specialized treatments for a wide range of dental and oral health issues, restoring function and aesthetics.

0.title: Cavities & Decay
0.description: Treatment of tooth decay with fillings, inlays, and onlays to restore tooth integrity.

1.title: Gum Disease
1.description: Periodontal therapy to treat gingivitis and periodontitis, protecting your gum health.

2.title: Tooth Loss
2.description: Restoration options including bridges, dentures, and implants for missing teeth.

3.title: Misalignment
3.description: Orthodontic solutions to correct crooked teeth and bite issues for children and adults.

expertise.title: Services & Procedures
expertise.description: We offer a comprehensive suite of dental services tailored to your individual needs. Our goal is to provide pain-free, effective treatments using the latest techniques.

0.title: Routine Cleaning
0.description: Professional scaling and polishing to remove plaque and tartar buildup, preventing gum disease.

1.title: Teeth Whitening
1.description: Professional bleaching treatments to brighten your smile safely and effectively.

2.title: Dental Implants
2.description: Permanent, natural-looking replacements for missing teeth that function just like your own.

3.title: Orthodontics
3.description: Braces and clear aligners to correct bite issues and align teeth for a perfect smile.

technology.title: Cutting-Edge Technology
technology.description: We invest in the latest dental technologies to provide accurate diagnoses and effective treatments. Our modern facility is equipped to handle all your dental needs with precision.

x-rays.title: Digital X-Rays
x-rays.description: Low-radiation imaging for detailed views of teeth and jaw structure instantly.

cameras.title: Intraoral Cameras
cameras.description: High-resolution cameras that allow you to see what the dentist sees in real-time.

cta.description: Your oral health is our priority. Schedule your visit with our expert dental team today and experience the difference.

seo.title: Laboratory Department
seo.description: Advanced clinical laboratory with 24/7 operation. Comprehensive diagnostic testing and accurate results you can trust.

hero.description: Our ISO-certified laboratory operates 24/7 to deliver fast, accurate diagnostic results. From routine blood work to advanced molecular testing, we support your health journey with precision.

intro.title: Our Laboratory Services
intro.description: Comprehensive diagnostic testing across multiple disciplines to support accurate diagnosis and treatment monitoring.

biochemistry.title: Biochemistry
biochemistry.description: Liver function, kidney profiles, lipid panels, and metabolic screening with high precision.

hematology.title: Hematology
hematology.description: Complete blood counts, coagulation studies, and anemia profiling for blood disorders.

microbiology.title: Microbiology
microbiology.description: Culture & sensitivity, viral serology, and infectious disease identification.

molecular.title: Molecular
molecular.description: PCR testing, genetic screening, and cancer biomarkers for precision medicine.

0.title: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
0.description: Essential screening for anemia, infections, and blood disorders. Provides detailed analysis of red cells, white cells, and platelets.

1.title: Comprehensive Metabolic Panel
1.description: Evaluates kidney and liver function, electrolyte balance, and blood sugar levels for overall health assessment.

2.title: Lipid Profile
2.description: Measures cholesterol levels (LDL, HDL, triglycerides) to assess cardiovascular disease risk.

features.title: Fast & Accurate Results

automated.title: Automated Systems
automated.description: State-of-the-art analyzers from leading manufacturers ensure consistent, error-free results with rapid turnaround times.

home.title: Home Collection
home.description: Professional phlebotomy service at your doorstep. Book online and receive digital reports directly to your email.

features.quote: Most routine test results available within 4-6 hours. 99.9% accuracy rate with ISO certification.

cta.description: Fast, accurate results you can trust. Request your lab test today or schedule a home collection for your convenience.

seo.title: Radiology Department
seo.description: Diagnostic imaging excellence including MRI, CT Scans, Ultrasound, and X-Rays with low-dose radiation protocols.

hero.description: Our Radiology Department utilizes advanced imaging technology to provide precise diagnoses. We prioritize patient comfort and safety while delivering high-quality visual data.

intro.title: Conditions We Treat
intro.description: Our imaging capabilities allow us to detect and monitor a wide range of medical conditions with exceptional clarity.

fracture.title: Fracture Detection
fracture.description: Precise identification of bone fractures, dislocations, and joint abnormalities using high-resolution X-rays.

tumor.title: Tumor Screening
tumor.description: Early detection and staging of tumors in soft tissues and organs through advanced MRI and CT scanning.

cardiovascular.title: Cardiovascular Imaging
cardiovascular.description: Detailed visualization of heart structure and blood flow to identify blockages and heart conditions.

organ.title: Organ Health
organ.description: Comprehensive assessment of internal organs including liver, kidneys, and lungs for function and pathology.

procedures.title: Services & Procedures
procedures.description: State-of-the-art diagnostic imaging excellence for precise medical insights.

xray.title: Digital X-Ray
xray.description: High-resolution digital radiography for quick and accurate assessment of bones and chest with minimal radiation exposure.

mammography.title: 3D Mammography
mammography.description: Advanced tomosynthesis technology that provides a three-dimensional view of breast tissue for earlier cancer detection.

mri.title: MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging)
mri.description: Detailed imaging of soft tissues, organs, and the nervous system using strong magnetic fields and radio waves.

ct.title: CT Scans (Computed Tomography)
ct.description: Cross-sectional images of the body used to diagnose complex conditions, guide biopsies, and monitor treatment effectiveness.

technology.title: Advanced Technology
technology.description: We invest in the latest imaging technology to ensure the highest quality results with the lowest possible risk to our patients. Our facility is equipped with next-generation scanners and software.

ai.title: AI-Assisted Imaging Analysis
ai.description: Utilizing artificial intelligence to assist radiologists in detecting subtle abnormalities earlier and more accurately.

lowRad.title: Low-Radiation Equipment
lowRad.description: Our CT and X-ray systems are optimized to reduce radiation dose by up to 60% without compromising image quality.

cta.description: Whether you need a routine screening or a complex diagnostic procedure, our radiology team is here to provide exceptional care.

seo.title: Neurology Department
seo.description: Advanced care for brain, spine, and nervous system disorders. Specialized in stroke, epilepsy, and migraine treatment.

hero.description: Our Neurology Department provides world-class diagnosis and treatment for complex disorders of the nervous system. We combine cutting-edge technology with compassionate care.

intro.title: Conditions We Treat
intro.description: Our specialists have extensive experience in diagnosing and managing a wide range of neurological conditions.

stroke.title: Stroke
stroke.description: Rapid response stroke care with thrombolytic therapy and comprehensive rehabilitation programs.

epilepsy.title: Epilepsy
epilepsy.description: Advanced seizure management, EEG monitoring, and surgical options for epilepsy control.

alzheimer.title: Alzheimer's
alzheimer.description: Compassionate care for memory disorders, early diagnosis, and support for patients and families.

migraine.title: Migraine
migraine.description: Specialized headache clinic offering personalized treatment plans for chronic migraines and headaches.

procedures.title: Services & Procedures
procedures.description: Specialized diagnostic and therapeutic procedures for nervous system disorders.

eeg.title: EEG (Electroencephalogram)
eeg.description: A non-invasive test that records electrical patterns of the brain, essential for diagnosing epilepsy and other brain disorders.

nerve.title: Nerve Conduction Studies
nerve.description: Tests to measure how fast an electrical impulse moves through your nerve, used to identify nerve damage.

rehab.title: Neurorehabilitation
rehab.description: A complex medical process which aims to aid recovery from a nervous system injury, and to minimize and/or compensate for any functional alterations.

technology.title: Advanced Technology

item1.title: 3T MRI Scanner
item1.description: Provides exceptional image quality for detailed brain and spine imaging, allowing for earlier and more accurate diagnoses of neurological conditions.

item2.title: CT Angiography
item2.description: Combines a CT scan with an injection of dye to produce pictures of blood vessels and tissues, crucial for stroke assessment.

technology.quote: We invest in the latest technology to ensure our patients have access to the most precise diagnostic tools available.

cta.description: Early diagnosis can make a significant difference. Schedule an appointment with our specialists today.

seo.title: Pediatrics Department
seo.description: Compassionate medical care for infants, children, and adolescents. Child-friendly environment and expert pediatricians.

hero.description: From newborns to adolescents, our dedicated team of pediatricians provides comprehensive medical care in a warm, child-friendly environment.

intro.title: Conditions We Treat
intro.description: We specialize in diagnosing and treating a wide range of childhood conditions, ensuring your child grows up healthy and strong. Our approach focuses on preventive care and early intervention.

illness.title: Childhood Illnesses
illness.description: Diagnosis and treatment of common infections, fevers, flu, and chronic conditions like asthma.

vaccination.title: Vaccinations
vaccination.description: Comprehensive immunization schedules to protect your child from serious preventable diseases.

development.title: Developmental Delays
development.description: Monitoring growth milestones and providing early intervention for developmental concerns.

nutrition.title: Nutrition & Diet
nutrition.description: Expert guidance on breastfeeding, formula, introduction to solids, and healthy eating habits.

procedures.title: Services & Procedures
procedures.description: Specialized pediatric care and procedures tailored to the unique needs of children.

newborn.title: Newborn Care
newborn.description: Complete physical exams, screening tests, and care for newborns immediately after delivery and in the first few weeks of life.

wellchild.title: Well-Child Visits
wellchild.description: Regular health supervision visits to track growth, development, behavior, and general well-being at key ages.

surgery.title: Pediatric Surgery
surgery.description: Surgical care for children ranging from minor procedures to complex operations, performed by specialized pediatric surgeons.

adolescent.title: Adolescent Medicine
adolescent.description: Specialized care addressing the physical, psychological, and social needs of teenagers and young adults.

facility.title: Child-Friendly Facility
facility.subtitle: Designed for Comfort
facility.description: Our pediatric wing is distinct from the main hospital, featuring bright colors, play areas, and patient rooms designed to reduce anxiety. We believe that a healing environment is just as important as the medical care we provide.

cta.description: Give your child the gift of good health. Our expert pediatricians provide compassionate care in a warm, child-friendly environment. Book your visit today.

seo.title: Surgery Department
seo.description: State-of-the-art surgical care utilizing minimally invasive techniques and robotic technology for faster recovery.

hero.description: Our Surgery Department combines world-class surgeons with cutting-edge technology to deliver precise, minimally invasive, and effective surgical care tailored to your needs.

intro.title: Conditions We Treat
intro.description: We provide comprehensive surgical solutions for a wide range of medical conditions.

appendicitis.title: Appendicitis
appendicitis.description: Emergency and planned removal of the appendix using laparoscopic techniques.

hernias.title: Hernias
hernias.description: Repair of inguinal, umbilical, and hiatal hernias with mesh reinforcement.

gallbladder.title: Gallbladder Issues
gallbladder.description: Treatment for gallstones and inflammation, typically via cholecystectomy.

trauma.title: Trauma
trauma.description: Critical care surgery for injuries resulting from accidents and emergencies.

expertise.title: Services & Procedures
expertise.description: We specialize in a broad spectrum of surgical procedures, prioritizing patient safety and recovery speed through innovation.

minimally.title: Minimally Invasive Surgery
minimally.description: Utilizing small incisions to reduce pain, scarring, and recovery time for patients undergoing complex operations.

laparoscopy.title: Laparoscopy
laparoscopy.description: Diagnostic and therapeutic procedures using a small camera to guide surgical instruments with high precision.

general.title: General Surgery
general.description: Routine and complex operations on abdominal organs, thyroid, skin, breast, and soft tissues.

postoperative.title: Post-Operative Care
postoperative.description: Comprehensive monitoring and rehabilitation plans to ensure optimal healing and return to daily activities.

technology.title: Advanced Surgical Technology
technology.description: We invest in the latest surgical innovations to provide safer, more accurate, and less invasive treatments for our patients.

robotic.title: Robotic Surgical Systems
robotic.description: Enhanced precision and control for complex procedures, reducing recovery times significantly.

imaging.title: High-Definition Imaging
imaging.description: Real-time, crystal-clear visualization of internal anatomy during laparoscopic procedures.

cta.description: Take the first step towards better health. Our surgical team is ready to provide you with a personalized treatment plan.

seo.title: Ophthalmology Department
seo.description: Advanced eye care and vision preservation. Treating cataracts, glaucoma, and offering LASIK surgery.

hero.description: Our world-class ophthalmology team combines expertise with cutting-edge technology to diagnose, treat, and manage all conditions of the eye.

conditions.title: Conditions We Treat
conditions.description: We provide comprehensive diagnosis and treatment for a wide range of ocular conditions affecting patients of all ages.

cataracts.title: Cataracts
cataracts.description: Clouding of the eye's natural lens, leading to decreased vision. We offer advanced laser-assisted cataract surgery.

glaucoma.title: Glaucoma
glaucoma.description: A group of eye conditions that damage the optic nerve. Early detection and treatment are crucial to prevent vision loss.

macular.title: Macular Degeneration
macular.description: Age-related condition affecting the central part of the retina. We provide therapies to slow progression and manage symptoms.

diabetic.title: Diabetic Retinopathy
diabetic.description: A complication of diabetes that affects the eyes. We offer regular screenings and advanced treatments like laser photocoagulation.

services.title: Services & Procedures
services.description: We utilize the latest surgical techniques and technology to ensure the best possible outcomes for our patients. Our facilities are equipped for both outpatient procedures and complex surgeries.

lasik.title: Laser Eye Surgery (LASIK)
lasik.description: Correct vision problems such as nearsightedness, farsightedness, and astigmatism using precision lasers.

exams.title: Routine Eye Exams
exams.description: Comprehensive vision testing and health checks to maintain optimal eye health and detect issues early.

retinal.title: Retinal Procedures
retinal.description: Advanced treatments for retinal detachments, tears, and other complex back-of-the-eye conditions.

corneal.title: Corneal Transplants
corneal.description: Surgical replacement of damaged corneal tissue to restore vision in patients with corneal disease.

technology.title: Advanced Diagnostic Systems
technology.description: Precision is everything in eye care. We invest in the latest optical technologies to ensure accurate diagnoses and successful treatment outcomes.

oct.title: Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT)
oct.description: Non-invasive imaging that uses light waves to take cross-section pictures of your retina, allowing us to see each distinct layer.

diagnostic.title: Laser Diagnostic Systems
diagnostic.description: State-of-the-art laser mapping tools that create a detailed 3D map of your eye's surface for perfectly customized treatments.

cta.description: Don't let vision problems limit your life. Our expert ophthalmologists are here to provide the personalized care you deserve. Schedule your consultation now.

hero.description: Our dedicated team of therapists and specialists help you regain strength, mobility, and independence. We create personalized recovery plans tailored to your specific needs.

conditions.title: Conditions We Treat
conditions.description: We specialize in treating a wide range of conditions to help you return to your daily activities pain-free.

sports.title: Sports Injuries
sports.description: Comprehensive rehabilitation for ACL tears, rotator cuff injuries, and sprains to get athletes back in the game safely.

stroke.title: Stroke Recovery
stroke.description: Neurological rehabilitation focused on relearning skills and improving mobility after a stroke event.

surgical.title: Post-Surgical Rehab
surgical.description: Guided recovery programs following joint replacements, spinal surgeries, and other major procedures.

chronic.title: Chronic Pain
chronic.description: Management strategies and therapies for back pain, arthritis, fibromyalgia, and other long-term pain conditions.

services.title: Services & Procedures
services.description: Our department is equipped with modern facilities and expert staff to provide a full spectrum of rehabilitation services designed for your unique recovery journey.

physical.title: Physical Therapy
physical.description: Focuses on improving movement, strength, and function through exercise, manual therapy, and education.

occupational.title: Occupational Therapy
occupational.description: Helps patients develop, recover, or maintain the daily living and work skills ensuring independence.

pain.title: Pain Management
pain.description: Multidisciplinary approach to diagnose, prevent, and treat chronic pain using various therapeutic techniques.

technology.title: Advanced Technology
technology.description: We utilize cutting-edge equipment to accelerate your recovery.

mobility.title: Advanced Mobility Aids
mobility.description: State-of-the-art robotic exoskeletons and computerized gait trainers to assist in walking re-education.

therapeutic.title: Therapeutic Equipment
therapeutic.description: Specialized hydrotherapy pools, electrical stimulation devices, and ultrasound therapy units.

cta.description: Take the first step towards a pain-free life. Schedule a consultation with our rehabilitation experts and get back to doing what you love.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: Welcome to Everleaf Medical Center ("we," "our," or "us"). This page contains our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. By accessing our website, booking appointments, or using our services, you agree to comply with these terms and consent to our data practices.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.content: By accessing this website, you accept these terms and conditions in full. Do not continue to use Everleaf Medical Center's website if you do not accept all of the terms and conditions stated on this page.

list.license: License: Unless otherwise stated, Everleaf Medical Center and/or its licensors own the intellectual property rights for all material on this website. All intellectual property rights are reserved.
list.conduct: User Conduct: You must not use this website in any way that causes, or may cause, damage to the website or impairment of the availability or accessibility of the website.
list.security: Account Security: If you create an account or book an appointment, you are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your personal information and booking details.

disclaimer.title: Medical Disclaimer
disclaimer.subtitle: Not Medical Advice
disclaimer.content: The content provided on this website, including blog articles, service descriptions, and other materials, is for informational purposes only. It is <1>not intended to be a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.</1> Always seek the advice of your physician or other qualified health provider with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition. Never disregard professional medical advice or delay in seeking it because of something you have read on this website.
disclaimer.emergency: In case of a medical emergency, call 911 immediately.

protection.title: Data Protection Principles
protection.content: We adhere to the principles of data protection as set out in the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and HIPAA guidelines. Your data will be:
list: Processed lawfully, fairly, and in a transparent manner.
Collected for specified, explicit, and legitimate purposes.
Adequate, relevant, and limited to what is necessary.
Kept accurate and up to date.

collection.title: Information Collection
collection.content: We collect several different types of information for various purposes to provide and improve our Service to you.

personal.title: Personal Data
personal.content: While using our Service, we may ask you to provide us with certain personally identifiable information that can be used to contact or identify you ("Personal Data"). This may include, but is not limited to: Email address, First name and last name, Phone number, Address, State, Province, ZIP/Postal code, City.

medical.title: Medical Data
medical.content: When you book an appointment or visit our facility, we collect health information necessary for your care. This is protected under strict medical privacy laws (HIPAA/GDPR).

usage.title: Usage Data
usage.content: We may also collect information how the Service is accessed and used ("Usage Data"). This Usage Data may include information such as your computer's Internet Protocol address (e.g. IP address), browser type, browser version, the pages of our Service that you visit, the time and date of your visit, the time spent on those pages, unique device identifiers and other diagnostic data.

rights.title: Your Rights as a Patient
rights.content: Under data protection law, you have rights including:

access.title: Right of Access
access.content: You have the right to ask us for copies of your personal medical information.

rectification.title: Right to Rectification
rectification.content: You have the right to ask us to rectify personal information you think is inaccurate.

erasure.title: Right to Erasure
erasure.content: You have the right to ask us to erase your personal information in certain circumstances.

restriction.title: Right to Restriction
restriction.content: You have the right to ask us to restrict the processing of your personal information.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track the activity on our Service and hold certain information. You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. However, if you do not accept cookies, you may not be able to use some portions of our Service.

contact.title: Questions about our Privacy Policy?
contact.subtitle: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us. Our dedicated data protection officer will be happy to assist you.
